WITH fee_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) as overall_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.avg_rebtotal,
    fs.avg_net_fee_rate,
    fs.avg_net_fee_rate - os.overall_net_fee_rate as excess
  FROM fee_stats fs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE fs.avg_net_fee_rate > os.overall_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM filtered_orders
